worldcombat.skill.snatch.summary: Put out a hand and take the move the chosen foe is about to use on itself, applying it to yourself; if it never commits a stealable move the hand closes on nothing.
worldcombat.skill.snatch.use.0: Take the boost a foe is about to give itself
worldcombat.skill.snatch.use.1: Cut off a foe's recovery or setup
worldcombat.skill.snatch.use.2: Steal a foe's preparation before the fight starts
worldcombat.skill.snatch.description.0: After %1$s of wind-up the hand waits in front of the target for %2$s; any self-buff or recovery move it commits in that time is turned back and used by you instead.
worldcombat.skill.snatch.description.1: Reach: %1$s blocks. The current cast range is %3$s blocks and requires a clear line of sight.
worldcombat.skill.snatch.description.2: The cooldown between grabs is %1$s. An empty window costs nothing; a stolen move is settled with your own stats.
worldcombat.skill.snatch.patient.on: Bide: the open hand lasts x1.5, to wait out a slower setup; it costs +3 ticks wind-up and x1.2 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.snatch.patient.off: Snap: -2 ticks wind-up and x0.85 cooldown to grab a beat sooner; the open hand lasts x0.9.
worldcombat.skill.snatch.timing: Cast on a single enemy: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to open the hand; the recovery is %3$s, the cooldown %5$s from commit, and the current range %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.snatch.growth.0: At level %1$s the reach grows to %2$s blocks and the hand waits %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.snatch.growth.1: At level %1$s the reach grows to %2$s blocks and the hand waits %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.snatch.preference.pati: Bide: open hand x1.5, +3 ticks wind-up, x1.2 cooldown, to wait for a slower setup. Snap: -2 ticks wind-up, x0.85 cooldown, open hand x0.9, to grab a single beat.
worldcombat.skill.snatch.preference.ai.m: The partner only reaches out while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee, larger chases out to wait for the grab.
worldcombat.skill.snatch.preference.ai.o: Wait for setup: only reach out when the foe's last move was stealable, or it is not attacking right now. Anytime: reach out at any threat as a pure gamble.
worldcombat.skill.snatch.preference.ai.l: When on, the partner will also leave its post to reach out.
